11. The Great Inventor

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A villager has spent all morning wondering why the ocean is salty: ask a scientist, or invent an answer.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has spent the entire morning wondering why the ocean is salty. (subject.He/She) has heard several explanations, none entirely convincing. By afternoon (subject.he/she) has begun wondering why rain is not salty, why some lakes are salty, and whether fish notice the difference.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (friend) explains what (friend.he/she) knows about dissolved minerals, rivers, evaporation, and the movement of water. (subject) listens carefully. "But why does the sea have so MUCH salt?" (subject.he/she) asks. The discussion continues until sunset. Neither is entirely satisfied.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: "Perhaps an enormous sea creature spilled its soup," (subject) suggests. (friend) considers this. "That would be a very large bowl." They spend the next hour calculating how large. Neither claims the explanation is true.
